details.description: Phi-3-mini-128k-instruct is a 3.8-billion-parameter, dense decoder-only Transformer from Microsoft's Phi-3 family, instruction-tuned with supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization and built for memory- and latency-constrained deployments. Microsoft trained it on 4.9 trillion tokens of filtered public documents, synthetic "textbook-like" data and high-quality chat data, with training completed in May-June 2024 and a knowledge cutoff of October 2023, and it supports a 128K-token context window. The model card targets it at reasoning, coding and math tasks, and Microsoft's page for the Phi-3 family now also links to newer Phi-4 mini and multimodal instruct models.
advantages: Scores 69.7 on MMLU, 60.4 on HumanEval, and 85.3 on GSM8K (chain-of-thought), per Microsoft's model card benchmark table.
Supports a 128K-token context window for long-document and retrieval-style tasks, per the model card.
Built for memory- and compute-constrained, latency-sensitive deployment scenarios, per the model card.
disadvantages: Degraded performance on non-English languages and underrepresented English varieties, per the model card.
Knowledge cutoff of October 2023 limits awareness of more recent events, per the model card.
Code generation focuses primarily on Python with common packages, per the model card.
Microsoft's Hugging Face page for the Phi-3 family now also links to newer Phi-4 mini and multimodal instruct models.
use_cases: Reasoning-heavy tasks such as code and math problem solving
Long-context tasks up to 128K tokens, e.g. document analysis or retrieval-augmented generation
General-purpose instruction following in memory- or latency-constrained deployments

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens (131072) match the model card's stated 128K-token context window. The model card's English-primary/degraded-other-languages statement is not an enumerated language list, so languages is left empty. Microsoft's page links to newer Phi-4 mini/multimodal models but does not explicitly state Phi-3-mini-128k-instruct is deprecated, so it is noted as a disadvantage rather than as deprecation.
